crossRefs.note: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

translations.web: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
translations.bsb: Listen, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart on the right course.
translations.kjv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
translations.asv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, And guide thy heart in the way.
